purpose: Discriminate front-end delivery or instruction-cache effects behind the unchanged-instruction-count AArch64 raw layout regression.
controls: Unchanged frozen source, ordinary iterator-only control, added-leaf-only control, full candidate and byte-identical A/A. Preserve fixed and original-image native timings.
selection: Four attempts preflight only core PMU capability before source build; all attempts retained. No selection by CPU identity or measured performance.
event_policy: Use perf-listed named events, probe each group, record unsupported or unscheduled groups. All supported groups use balanced rotations and reverse order. Zero baselines retain counts/deltas without a ratio.
limits: PMU covers unchanged whole process, including initialization and warm-up. Speculative front-end events are not retired instructions and cannot be attributed to an individual instruction. Association is evidence to guide the next intervention, not exact proof of a cache mechanism.
